items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He's still going strong. He had a fella named Abby Burney's hat that sewed up over there.

ctx.x: He's still going strong. He had a fella named Abby Burney's hat that sewed up over there. They got two bands. Oh, yeah.
And Isaiah, Andrew. Oh, they took a minute to dance with him. I see him for a long time. That's how he lost his voice.
